title: The structural unit of the section algebra has degree zero.
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme and let $A$ be a quasi-coherent commutative unital graded $\mathcal O_X$-algebra datum [def-nagata-relative-proj], in the sheaf presentation with homogeneous pieces $A_n$ and graded unit $u:\mathcal O_X\to A_0$ [def-weil-pbc-graded-sheaf-structures]. Write $\mathcal B$ for its underlying algebra sheaf, $\eta:\mathcal O_X\to\mathcal B$ for its structural map, and $e:\bigoplus_{n\geq0}A_n\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal B$ for the given identification of underlying module sheaves. This identification respects the graded unit and multiplication, as in the datum `RelativeProjAlgebra`. For each open $U$ let $i_{n,U}:A_n(U)\to\mathcal B(U)$ be the map induced by the degree-$n$ coproduct inclusion followed by $e$, so unit compatibility is $i_{0,U}(u_U(r))=\eta_U(r)$ for $r\in\mathcal O_X(U)$. For an affine open $V\subseteq X$, put $C_V=\mathcal B(V)$ and define $\operatorname{sectionGrade}_A(V,n)=\operatorname{im}(i_{n,V})$ as an additive subgroup of $C_V$. Then for every affine open $V\subseteq X$ and every $r\in\mathcal O_X(V)$ one has
$$\eta_V(r)\in\operatorname{sectionGrade}_A(V,0).$$
